main_text.p: Exod.c. 2.Actor. c.7,v.27,tibus opitulari. Ita Moses vi-rum Ægyptium, indignis mo-dis tractantem ac percutien-tem, quendam ex Hebræis, fratribus seu cognatis impigre occidit. Quod etiam factum S. Spiritus per Stephanum protomartyrem comprobavit. Gen. 14. v. 14. & seq.Abraham itidem ad defensio-nem sui nepotis Lothi contra vim regum qui Sodomitas subjugaverant, familiam suam armavit, factoque illi accessit Dist.c.14. v.19.20.approbatio divina. Melchise-deck enim ei à cæde regum re-deunti factus obviam benedix-it, Deoque gratias egit, pro ejusdem liberatione.
main_text.head: CAP. XXVII.

head.i: Vtrum ad solam rerum defensionem furem occidere liceat?

main_text.p: TAnta est inter homines au-ri sacra fames, tanta bonorum

page.notes: The initial "T" of "TAnta" is a large woodcut letter, joined to the word as printed. The line "illi" reads "illj" in the scan, rendered as "illi". The mark after "armavit" is a small comma-like sign, rendered as a comma. No catchword or signature is visible. The paragraph beginning "TAnta" continues on the next page, since "bonorum" is not broken with a hyphen.
